name: MA Cross
summary: This EA implements a moving average crossover strategy, generating buy signals when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. It is a classic trend-following system that aims to capture directional moves by entering after crossover confirmation. The EA automatically opens and manages positions based on these MA crossover signals.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了移动平均线交叉策略，当快速均线从下方穿越慢速均线时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，旨在通过交叉确认后入场来捕捉方向性行情。EA根据均线交叉信号自动开仓和管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双移动平均线交叉策略作为核心交易逻辑，属于典型的趋势跟踪型策略。入场条件为快速均线与慢速均线发生交叉——金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号平仓或止损止盈设置，但具体取决于参数配置。仓位管理基于手数参数固定开仓，未提及动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，EA可能依赖用户自行设定的固定手数或风险比例，缺乏自适应的资金管理模块。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual moving average crossover strategy as its core trading logic, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are triggered when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA for buy signals (golden cross) and below for sell signals (death cross). Exit conditions typically rely on a reverse crossover signal to close positions or on stop-loss/take-profit levels, depending on parameter configuration. Position sizing is based on a fixed lot parameter without dynamic adjustment mechanisms. Money management relies on user-configured fixed lot sizes or risk ratios, lacking an adaptive money management module. The strategy performs well in strongly trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy market conditions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证，适合初学者学习趋势跟踪概念
趋势行情中能有效捕捉中长期方向性行情，盈亏比潜力较好
参数较少，优化空间明确，不易出现过拟合问题
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and validate, suitable for beginners learning trend-following concepts
Effectively captures medium-to-long-term directional moves in trending markets with good risk-reward potential
Few parameters with clear optimization space, reducing the risk of overfitting
cons: 震荡市中频繁产生虚假交叉信号，导致连续小额亏损累积
均线交叉本身具有滞后性，入场价格往往远离最优点位
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，风险控制依赖手动参数设置
cons_en: Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets lead to accumulated consecutive small losses
MA crossover inherently has lag, causing entry prices to often be far from optimal levels
Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, relying on manually configured parameters for risk control
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更大周期均线）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
引入动态仓位管理模块，根据账户余额和波动率自适应调整手数
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or higher timeframe MA) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Introduce a dynamic position sizing module that adapts lot size based on account balance and market volatility

risk_points: 震荡市中缺乏过滤机制，可能产生频繁的虚假交易信号
固定手数无动态资金管理，大资金使用时风险敞口不可控
若未设置止损，单笔交易可能出现较大亏损
risk_points_en: Lacks filtering mechanism in ranging markets, potentially generating frequent false trading signals
Fixed lot size without dynamic money management creates uncontrolled risk exposure with larger accounts
Without stop-loss configured, single trades may incur significant losses
